entities.name: Sword Marches
entities.description: Most contested land on Terisiare before the Brothers' War, later glass wastes and then submerged.

entities.name: Warlord of Kroog
entities.description: Conqueror who annexed Fallaji land into Yotia.

events.summary: The Warlord of Kroog conquers Fallaji land along the Mardun and annexes it into Yotia.
events.quote: was conquered by the Warlord of Kroog and annexed into Yotia

events.summary: The Sword Marches dispute helps cause the failure of the peace talks and the start of the Brothers' War.
events.quote: directly attributing to the start of the Brothers' War

events.summary: By 55 AR the fighting leaves the Marches a field of blackened glass.
events.quote: a field of blackened glass, completely unlivable

events.summary: After the Ice Age begins the wastes freeze into the Adarkar Wastes, later submerged.
events.quote: froze over and became part of the much larger Adarkar Wastes

relations.quote: the Fallaji never gave up their ancestral claims to the land
